text: Haffan stated with this victory, in which he had Haffan re vary little fhares, undertook an expedition againl the doces Trekking of Temsman, who, being now deprived of the dirt recent.

parsed.faithful: Haffan, elated with this victory, in which he had very little share, undertook an expedition against the king of Tremecen, who, being now deprived of the assistance of the Spaniards, was forced to procure a peace
parsed.modern: Hassan, elated with this victory, in which he had very little share, undertook an expedition against the king of Tremecen, who, being now deprived of the assistance of the Spaniards, was forced to procure a peace
